push.title: W 4-0 vs Fruitguys Fc | You: 9.7 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
buddskees, a 9.7. That's your best match performance of the season, and you earned every decimal.

THE GOOD
+ 2 shots at Fruitguys Fc's goal. The keeper's arms are probably still sore.
+ 1 assist. Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football.
+ Man of the Match, your 16th for us. You led by example, and the example was excellent.
+ Every time you found BellyTb1, something good happened.
+ That 9.7 sits as your best match performance of the season. Lovely stuff.

THE BAD
- On-ball actions 6, down from your usual 32. We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. That's the one I'd circle in red.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. We don't hide from that one; we fix it.

Practice pointer: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.

buddskees, take this with you: Champions are just ordinary folks who kept showing up.

Take a bow. - Coach Lasso

+ Pass accuracy 100%, up from your usual 78%. That's what showing up looks like.
+ Won your matchup: 8.7 against their best forward's 5.7. That's the stuff I want framed.

The team's lucky to have you. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-0 vs Fruitguys Fc | You: 8.0
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.0 against Fruitguys Fc. You're trending up like a hot-air balloon at the fair.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few.
+ You & buddskees clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ 7th straight match at 7.5 match rating. That's the stuff I want framed.
+ Better completed passes than any of their humans (5 vs their best 0). Gold star, no notes.
+ Part of a 4-0 beating of Fruitguys Fc. Everybody gets a slice of that pie.

THE BAD
- No shots. Best practice: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.
- 71% passing (5 of 7, down from your usual 86%). Try it this way: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 2. Focus point: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.
- Lowest match rating on the team: 8.0 (best was buddskees's 9.7). That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.

Coach's drill: Follow every shot in. Rebounds are free goals for people who keep running.

Hey PhogsToffees, hold onto this one: A good teammate is like a good umbrella. You don't notice 'em till it rains.

Champions have off days too. - Coach Lasso
